items.source: Returns the command represented by the given key, otherwise returns RedisCommand.UNKNOWN if no matching command could be found.
items.translation: 返回由给定 `key` 表示的命令；如果找不到匹配的命令，则返回 RedisCommand.UNKNOWN。

items.source: Enumeration of well-known Redis commands.
items.translation: Enumeration 包含著名的 Redis 命令。

items.source: Core package for integrating Redis with Spring concepts.
items.translation: 用于将 Redis 与 Spring 概念集成的核心包。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，这些常量按照声明顺序排列。
